records.title: 10-K
records.text: In 2022, over 68% of our revenue was derived from consumable products and activity-based equipment, while the balance was primarily derived from capital products with a small amount from rental and other services.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: At the same time, the supply of oil and natural gas was impacted by ongoing capacity constraints by OPEC+ and North American exploration and production companies.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The $13.9 million improvement in segment operating results included the higher gross profit from the 12.7% increase in revenues discussed above, partially offset by higher freight and material costs as a result of inflationary pressures from global supply chains.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: As a result of these supply and demand factors, commodity prices increased substantially in 2021.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Segment operating income for the year ended December 31, 2022 was $9.1 million compared to a loss of $45.5 million for the year ended December 31, 2021.
